**Constraint found, worked around, noted for the PM** (`.bb/chats/thr_vg5x2ti649/notes/web-core.2-questions.md`): `src/generation.ts` is read-only (owns_paths enforced at fs level) and its `guiMode` enum — shared with the journal's recovery schema — has no web values. Setting `guiMode` on web records would make the journal *delete* them on reload recovery and gallery reads drop them. So web records store label/run/dir/files but no `guiMode` (server.ts:1394). A later task should add web modes there.

## Verification (all ran clean in this session)

- `node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/web.test.ts` → 9/9 pass

APPROACH: modelled `src/web.ts` on `src/roblox.ts` (same request→jobs shape, quoted/parseList reuse, gameLines-style site lines with palette added), put the favicon set composition in web.ts so tests exercise it without the bb runtime, and wired the section through server.ts's existing section-generic paths (runGui/exportGui/runGuiCommand) with only mode/category tables added.

LESSON: the read-only file mode is the real owns_paths boundary — when a shared schema (generation records) can't accept new values, route around it at the write site (omit the field) instead of forcing the schema, and check what the downstream validators (journal recovery, KV safeParse) would do to the data before choosing.

dispatchContext.rulesText:
- In verification scripts and tests that create temp dirs, use /tmp explicitly (mktemp -d /tmp/x.XXXXXX, or TMPDIR=/tmp): the writer sandbox denies mkdtemp in the system TMPDIR under /var/folders. Keep PM-written check scripts in /tmp/<name>/ (the guard blocks .mjs under .agents/).
- In a folder without git (live-folder mode), never put a task's expected_outputs or owns_paths under .bb/ (chat folders): the live snapshot skips .bb, so a file written there is never counted as produced and the task blocks as missing expected_outputs. Put task deliverables in a project folder such as docs/ or reports/.

{"summary":"Task web-core.2 introduces a fifth Image Studio section, 'web', dedicated to generating website graphics through muse-image, mirroring the architecture and conventions of the Roblox section in src/roblox.ts. Each website is organized as a project matching a site folder, with generated files saved under 'image-studio/web/<site>/<category>/<job>/'. The implementation requires creating src/web.ts and tests/web.test.ts, extending server.ts, implementing encodeIco in src/image-io.ts, and updating package.json to version 0.10.0.

src/web.ts will define WEB_MODEL ('muse-image'), 13 modes grouped across 3 categories ('concepts': ideas, page, mobile, block; 'brand': logo, favicon, og; 'graphics': hero, cover, illustrations, icons, background, pattern), LIST_MODES ('illustrations', 'icons'), MAX_LIST (illustrations <= 6, icons <= 16), VARIANT_MODES (all non-list modes except ideas, max 4 variants), and 9 style presets (minimal, corporate, playful, editorial, brutalist, dark-tech, luxury, flat-illustration, clay-3d). It will provide request validation, prompt building via webJobs(request, site), and manifest generation via webManifest(job, files). Project theme, palette, notes, presets, and references will be injected into prompts similar to gameLines() in roblox.ts, omitting Roblox-specific rules.

Mode deliverables and Muse aspect ratios are strictly specified: ideas (3:2, 4 takes cover 1536x1024; 4 presets if style unselected, else 4 takes in style), page (9:16, limit <= 2048), mobile (9:16, cover 1080x1920), block (16:9, cover 1920x1080), logo (16:9 green key, transparent <= 1024), favicon (1:1 green key multi-file favicon set), og (16:9, cover 1200x630), hero (16:9, cover 1920x1080 with calm headline space), cover (16:9, cover 1600x900), illustrations (green key sheet cut into <= 6 parts), icons (green key sheet cut into <= 16 square parts at 256 or 512), background (16:9, cover 1920x1080 without text), and pattern (1:1, 1024x1024 seamless tile).

server.ts will wire the 'web' section, expose CLI commands under 'bb image-studio web projects|project|ref|generate|delete' via runGuiCommand, and provide the agent tool 'image_studio_web'.
